WITH o.nationality AS nationality,

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH o.nationality AS nationality, SPLIT(o.birth_date, '/') AS parts
WITH nationality,
     2026 - CAST(parts[0] AS INT64) - CASE
       WHEN CAST(parts[1] AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(parts[1] AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(parts[2] AS INT64) > 14) THEN 1
       ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2
